This bounded independent CPU audit reads saved scalar rows and explicit execution metadata plus server-side snapshot booleans. It loads no model/checkpoint, weights, RGB, features or geometry and performs no forward/backward/update, old-GT reconstruction, preflight, test suite or external re-evaluation.

Population equality, initialization and checkpoint/RNG-save mechanisms are metadata/source-code evidence. Checkpoint contents were not loaded. Strict233-state reload is a saved preflight witness, not this auditor's reenactment.

RF100 scalar labels are offline derived from four annotated points. Historical GeoPRR paired comparisons use saved same-population outputs; historical pixels and the complete weight chain were not recertified.
